name: sdlc-skills
description: One plugin for coding agents: sdlc builds a change from criteria you write to a reviewed pull request, with hooks that decide when it is done. An optional second, working-agreement, sets how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Whoever made a change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done: a build skill where your acceptance criteria decide done, failing tests come first and a blind challenger holds some back, and fresh agents implement, review and verify; plus hooks for a test lock, a done check, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a holdout guard and a pull request size cap.

plugins.name: working-agreement
plugins.description: Optional house rules for how the agent works with you: keep it simple, look facts up instead of asking, one decision per question that yes accepts, and explanations that lead with what a thing means for you and a concrete case before the mechanism and its name. One hook adds them at session start.
